system.description: A small town on the outskirts of a nation or region
system.notes:
Standard | Social

A small town on the outskirts of a nation or region
Impulses: Drive the desperate to doom, profit off of ragged hope

Difficulty: 12

Features

Rumors Abound - Passive: Gossip is the fastest-traveling currency in the realm. A PC can inquire about major events by making a Charm Roll. What they learn depends on the outcome of their roll, based on the following criteria:

  • Critical Success: Learn about two major events. The PC can ask one follow-up question about one of the rumors and get a truthful (if not always complete) answer.
  • Success with Hope: Learn about two events, at least one of which is relevant to the character's background.
  • Success with Fear: Learn an alarming rumor related to the character's background.
  • Any Failure: The locals respond poorly to their inquiries. The PC must mark a Stress to learn one relevant rumor.

Rival Party - Passive: Another adventuring party is here, seeking the same lead as the PCs, or actively working against them.

It'd Be a Shame If... - Action: The PCs witness as agents of a local crime boss shake down a general goods store.

Wrong Place - Reaction: At night, spend a Fear to introduce a group of thieves who try to rob them. The thieves appear at Close range of a PC and include a Bandit Kneebreaker, as many Lackeys as there are PCs, and a Lieutenant.
